decisions.reason: As a floor-level shower drainage system, it sits at the center of the firm's accumulated drainage, installation, and waterproofing knowledge, so continued learning should support refinement rather than withdrawal.

Because this designer shower drainage line was positioned as a flagship and closely matches the firm's strategic move toward integrated, design-conscious bathroom solutions, it is highly likely to be retained.
The shower element with integrated slope builds directly on the firm's installation know-how and system-selling approach, giving management a strong basis to absorb feedback and improve the offer.

Although less central than the shower-focused lines, the backflow-protected basement floor drain still fits the firm's technical drainage competence and problem-solving reputation, so it is more likely to be kept than dropped.
